description: Gate: block irrecoverable Bash patterns (rm -rf, push --force, --no-verify, reset --hard, clean -f)

Gate: ask before a raw `gh pr merge` runs outside the ship-merge skill flow. Restores the merge-door protection convergence-merge-gate.sh used to provide before it was retired 2026-08-24 (#82) with no replacement. Emits permissionDecision: ask. Known non-goal: the REST equivalent (gh api .../pulls/N/merge) is not covered.

Gate: ask the human to approve edits to BOTH non-model verifiers — hooks/gates/** + hooks/advisory/** + hooks/hooks.json (deny-gates + advisory sensors + wiring) AND skills/meta/harness-audit/scripts/audit.sh + checks/** (audit grader). Tamper-resistance: the model cannot edit the code that judges it. Emits permissionDecision: ask (no env-var bypass). Also folds the former path-hardcode deny (blocks hardcoded /Users/<name> in .sh/.py/.js) since 2026-07-03; one fewer python3 spawn per Write/Edit. NotebookEdit added 2026-08-06.
Gate: ask the human to approve Bash-mediated writes (redirect, tee, sed -i, cp, mv) to verifier surfaces — closes the Write/Edit matcher's blind spot. Emits permissionDecision: ask.
Gate: ask on non-SELECT execute_sql-shaped MCP calls, on any server. No-op when no such MCP server is configured (matcher never fires).

Gate: a subagent may not mark its own task completed (maker≠checker). Only the main session completes tasks; validator subagents return verdicts to main. Denies TaskUpdate(status=completed) when agent_type is present (subagent). Exit 2 + stderr; fail-safe allow on parse error.
Marks the session jira-acli-engaged when a jira-acli:* skill loads, so the companion gate:mcp:atlassian-cold-start gate can allow-list it. Never blocks Skill itself.

Gate: block a direct Atlassian/Jira/Confluence MCP call before a jira-acli:* skill loaded this session — forces routing through jira-acli's templates instead of a cold MCP call. Escape: MH_ALLOW_DIRECT_ATLASSIAN_MCP=1.

Gate: block Read/Grep access to credential-bearing file paths (.env, id_rsa/id_ed25519/id_ecdsa, *.pem/*.key, service-account JSON, .netrc, .npmrc, .htpasswd), resolved via realpath to close symlink-indirection bypass. Read/Grep only; Bash-mediated reads are a scoped follow-up (#96).

Gate: ask before creating a brand-new Claude Code settings file (.claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json), and ask on an edit to an existing one that changes the hooks or enabledPlugins keys (verified by reconstructing the edit and comparing against the on-disk content) — every other key stays frictionless (#98).

Gate: ask when an edit to an existing test-shaped path (tests/**, test_*.py, *_test.*, *.test.*, *.spec.*) removes an assertion line or adds a skip/disable marker. Stateless content-diff classifier, no session-phase tracking. Enforces METHODOLOGY.md Rule 4 (don't weaken a test while fixing the code it covers) computationally instead of by prose alone.

Gate: redirect Edit/Write on a guarded sub-repo main checkout or protected branch into a session worktree under ~/.worktrees. Opt-in and off by default: no-op everywhere unless MH_GUARDED_WORKSPACE is set.

Gate: deny (not redirect) a Bash-mediated write that targets a guarded sub-repo main checkout or protected branch. Denies instead of redirecting: a raw shell command's target can't be rewritten via updatedInput the way file_path can. Opt-in and off by default.
